name: Majerska
title: Majerska's Cursed Canopy boss clearer
description: Travels to Majerska's Cursed Canopy on Earth (recall, Zeno Button, vortex, survey), reads `where` and kills every boss, weakest first, fighting off rivals. Type `maj help`.
author: Bruno Mouta

aliases.name: maj
aliases.script:
if matches[2] == "update" then return CKMudUpdate("Majerska") end
local function arg(s) if s and s ~= "" then return s end end
maj.command(arg(matches[2]), arg(matches[3]))
